description: This PHP source file defines the ImportMap class, which represents and manages import map configurations within the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties and methods for handling field mappings, default values, publication status, and database interactions related to import maps.

classes.name: ImportMap
classes.description: Represents an import mapping configuration in SuiteCRM, providing methods for managing field mappings, default values, publication status, and persistence.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns an associative array of field mappings parsed from the 'content' property.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Sets the 'content' property based on an associative array of field mappings.

methods.name: getDefaultValues
methods.description: Returns an associative array of default values parsed from the 'default_values' property.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets the 'default_values' property based on an associative array of default values.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the import map record by ID and sets default delimiter if source is 'tab'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the import map record to the database, delegating to internal _save method.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, updating fields and handling specific logic for enclosure characters.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks the import map as deleted if the user has permissions.

methods.name: mark_published
methods.description: Marks an import map as published or unpublished, ensuring no conflicts with other published maps.

methods.name: retrieve_all_by_string_fields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple import map objects matching specified string fields.

methods.name: set_get_import_wizard_fields
methods.description: Manages user preferences related to import wizard fields, including setting and retrieving stored preferences.
